description: List every quote for a shopping intent, cheapest first by monthly price (in USD cents); each policy has a coverageSummary. Pass up to 4 bundleIds to also get their coverages, discounts and payment plans, for example to compare them. Prices are estimates until priceStatus is final. Declined quotes are left out and counted in declinedCount. It doesn't request quotes.

bundleIds.description: Up to 4 bundle ids to return with coverages, discounts and payment plans. Omit to list every quote.

intentId.description: The shopping intent id returned by an earlier shopping tool.

name: jerry_get_quotes
title: View quotes
